what.text: This page follows people displaced inside Burundi, as counted by IDMC and by UNHCR, shown side by side and never added together.
At the end of 2025, IDMC counted 6815 people displaced by conflict and violence, and UNHCR's figure for IDPs of concern is the same, 6815.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Burundi in periods from 2003 to 2024, most recently with RED-TABARA.
IDMC's disaster records for Burundi list floods and storms.

when.text: IDMC's figures fell from 100000 in 2009 to 6815 in 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2017.

how.text: In 2025, IDMC recorded 1020 new displacements by conflict and violence: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Burundi.
